missing_values: Processed CSVs preserve blank or nan values; raw GeoTIFFs use -9999 as nodata. Missingness is not imputed. A present date is not necessarily usable. Model scripts filter nonpositive NO2 and wind/BLH where logs are required.
time_sampling: Original ERA5 exports use 12 and 13 UTC; TROPOMI clear-sky overpass sampling. See scripts and manuscript.
column_conventions: pct/lo/hi are percentage changes and interval endpoints unless explicitly named beta/slope/log; log coefficients and ventilation slopes are dimensionless; *_kt_yr is kt per year; n/n_windows are counts. The 2020 descriptive range is not a coverage-validated confidence interval.
quality: Original coverage threshold is at least 30% valid pixels in both disc and annulus; export product masking is documented in GEE scripts. NPZ clips retain qa_value and product/processor metadata.
npz_columns: Native Level-2 no2_trop_mol_m2 and precision are mol m-2, not µmol m-2. Coordinates are degrees, QA and kernels are dimensionless. Surface pressure and TM5 constants are native product quantities; use the conversion code and product documentation.
